verdict.rationale: Convex has background workflows (scheduler, crons), and those apply here, but the evidence pack documents no product feature for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. Pushing function code from the local filesystem, preview deployments, and daily data backups are adjacent features. Any git-based versioning would be a user-side workaround, not a Convex capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
